notes: MLXUI-authored (RSI/DelegateOCRPromptBacklog.md OCP-3-1 / AM-W, journals 2026-235 and 2026-236). catflow-mlx has no PaddleOCR-VL manifest to port -- the model was evaluated during SPEC-Q131 curation and rejected there (loads but emits internal weight-parameter names under that project's pinned mlx_vlm), so this file is authored here the same way glm-ocr-4bit.json is. `engine` is `paddleocr-vl`, not `mlx-vlm`: MLXUI runs PaddleOCR-VL through the vendored PaddleOCRVL pipeline (SUP-1, PaddleOCRStage/PaddleOCREngine), not MLXVLM, because MLXVLM's type registry has no `paddleocr_vl` architecture; `engine` is a dispatch key so it must name what actually runs. `settings.mode` (OCP-3-1) declares PaddleOCR-VL's four recognition modes as a positional enum -- the same set PaddleOCRSDK.promptSupport carries in Swift (journal 2026-229), pinned equal by paddleOCRVLManifestModeEnumMatchesTheSDK. OCP-3-5 (deriving PromptSupport.modes from this file instead of the hardcoded list) is deferred to land with VAL-1: a manifest-derived promptSupport has no consumer until MLXUI enforces manifest settings, and catflow-mlx will never carry a PaddleOCR-VL manifest to share the derivation with. resources.{disk_gb,ram_gb} are browser.json's downloadSizeGB / ramGB (the 1.5x-heuristic gate figures), not Python-measured numbers.
